pages.description: Meet Hunter Priniski, a UCLA postdoctoral fellow studying narrative agency and human–AI group communication, with work spanning research and new media.
pages.imageAlt: Hunter Priniski, PhD, research scientist inspiring human narratives.

pages.title: Narrative Agency & Human–AI Research | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Research on narrative agency, human–AI alignment, online networks, and health beliefs, combining group experiments, language analysis, and computational models.
pages.imageAlt: Hunter Priniski’s research in narrative agency and human–AI group alignment.

pages.title: New Media & Community Projects | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Narrative agency in practice through Digital Community Gardens, Vitality AZ, Faithscape and New Sage, and the mediaslop arcade and digests.
pages.imageAlt: Digital Community Gardens connects personal stories, shared concerns, and local action.

pages.title: Teaching | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Hunter Priniski’s approach to teaching and mentoring, connecting psychological research, computational methods, and students’ own questions and experiences.
pages.imageAlt: Hunter Priniski, PhD, research scientist and educator.

pages.title: AI & Computational Language Consulting | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Computational language analysis, behavioral research, and AI consulting with Hunter Priniski, including projects with Duke and PublicScholarship.org.
pages.imageAlt: Hunter Priniski, PhD: computational language analysis and behavioral research consulting.

pages.title: AI, Human Narratives & Narrative Agency | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: A narrative agency framework explaining how AI affects people’s ability to learn, communicate, and shape narratives, with implications for human–AI alignment.
pages.imageAlt: Psychological and communicative processes underlying narrative agency.

pages.title: Network Structure & Narrative Consensus | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: PNAS research showing how network structure and individual decisions shape shared hashtags and the narrative information people carry into their own accounts.
pages.imageAlt: Experimental design for studying narrative communication in human networks.

pages.title: Human–AI Group Communication & Alignment | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Ongoing experiments on how AI agents in group communication networks influence shared language, understanding of events, and perceptions of others’ beliefs.
pages.imageAlt: AI persona engineering and human–AI network interaction experiment.

pages.title: Generative Agents & Hashtag Coordination | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Benchmarking networked LLM agents against human hashtag coordination, revealing differences in convergence and the causal content of shared narratives.
pages.imageAlt: Hashtags most similar to narrative entities in human and LLM agent groups.

pages.title: Modeling Human Beliefs from Language | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: An AI pipeline maps expressed causal beliefs from language, applied to COVID-19 vaccine tweets and changes in personal narratives after group communication.
pages.imageAlt: Network of expressed causal beliefs extracted from COVID-19 vaccine tweets.

pages.title: Interactive Media & Belief Change | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Studies of arguments from Reddit’s Change My View and interactive educational media, testing how crowdsourced explanations shift attitudes on contested issues.
pages.imageAlt: Interactive map connecting historical redlining with present-day neighborhood income.

pages.title: Hashtag Activism & Online Narrative Power | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Research on hashtag activism, moral language after George Floyd’s killing, and QAnon networks, connecting collective attention with unequal narrative influence.
pages.imageAlt: Hashtag co-occurrence network from the QAnon knowledge-graph study.

pages.title: COVID-19 Skepticism & Distrust | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Preregistered surveys and Bayesian models trace how political distrust, vaccine fears, and other beliefs related to COVID-19 skepticism during the first U.S. wave.
pages.imageAlt: Survey responses linking COVID-19 skepticism with political, economic, and medical beliefs.

pages.title: Digital Community Gardens | Community-Led AI
pages.description: A planned civic platform using public art and community-led AI to connect residents’ stories, shared concerns, and local organizing around technology decisions.
pages.imageAlt: Digital Community Gardens: discover, explore, share, connect, and act.

pages.title: Vitality AZ | Community Storytelling & Placemaking
pages.description: A collaboration among Arizona residents, artists, developers, academics, and city leaders, connecting shared stories through Arizona Trail, public art, and events.
pages.imageAlt: Vitality AZ: growing community in the Valley of the Sun.

pages.title: Faithscape & New Sage | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: Research and public writing on meaning, belonging, religion, and neighborhood design, exploring how to build spirituality and community in secular spaces.
pages.imageAlt: New Sage wordmark: building spirituality in secular spaces.

pages.title: mediaslop | Arcade Games & Slop Digests
pages.description: Explore eight free mediaslop browser games about attention and online life, and sign up for slop digests with games, writing, and creative experiments.
pages.imageAlt: mediaslop Arcade poster featuring eight browser games.

pages.title: Narrative Alignment Python Notebook | Hunter Priniski
pages.description: A Python notebook demonstrating narrative alignment analysis for the Fukushima network experiment, linking hashtag language to events in a shared narrative.
pages.imageAlt: Methods for measuring narrative alignment and changes in personal accounts.
